label: Finding-112
title: weirdgloop-13h: 2 smaller precision and sourcing points
description: 94% is the operator's unaudited figure: No method is given for the 94% (it is "about" and credited to caching). Mark it as Weird Gloop's own figure. numbers.json carries it as a plain value "94%". | "From cache" and "page views" are paraphrase: The blog says "about 94% of wiki pageviews serving correctly, even with no database or PHP running" and credits "very aggressive caching"; it does not say all of them were served from cache. Also, impact.json's quote uses a straight apostrophe where the capture has U+2019 ("we_ve"): typographic only.
